roundStart: Round {round} begins; the Speaker has already lost control of it
Round {round}: members requested to keep their fists within the rules of the House
fightStart: Session called to order; order declines the invitation
The House is now in session; the Speaker is now in hiding
hit: {attacker} raises a very physical point of order against {defender}
{defender} objects to the last remark, which was a fist
{attacker} makes a strong case; {defender} makes a strong noise
block: {defender} invokes procedural defence; {attacker}'s motion does not pass
{attacker} moves a motion; {defender} moves a forearm
shield: {defender} cites parliamentary privilege; {attacker} bounces off it
{attacker} hits the privilege wall; privilege wins on a technicality
grab: {attacker} grabs {defender} and hoists the debate overhead
{attacker} lifts {defender} to a higher level of discussion
slam: {attacker} slams {defender} onto the floor of the House; motion carried
{defender} is flattened by a bill that was heavier than expected
knockdown: {defender} takes a sudden seat on the floor of the House
{defender} is now technically out of order and horizontal
special: {attacker} invokes {special}; the Speaker pretends not to see
ko: {defender} has left the House, not entirely by choice
{attacker} wins the debate by removing the other speaker
timeUp: Time is up; the House adjourns without a decision, as is tradition
Clock runs out; both sides declare victory immediately
